name: dp-it-giurisprudenza-grab
description: Downloads case-law sources into <dir>: Corte costituzionale open data dumps, Cassazione Solr pages (ItalGiure), CGT decisions (MEF DocTrib). Sidecar files for the convert class.
author: open-lex-it

execute.description: For each item fetch its source and write atomically (cc: dump zip + .dump.json; cassazione: Solr pages; cgt: slice and detail html). Failed keys end the run with an error. dryRun: no request.

items.description: the items to download, as reported by the detect step

dryRun.description: plan only: no request, nothing written

maxDocs.description: cassazione sample filter: stop after this many sentences

maxItems.description: cgt sample filter: stop after this many decisions

solrBaseUrl.description: cassazione: base URL of the ItalGiure host (default the official one)

verifyTls.description: cassazione and cgt: set false only if the certificate chain cannot be verified

allowedHosts.description: hosts the class may call (default the three source hosts)

output.description: { downloaded, unchanged, files: [{key, path, sidecar, status}] }
